scenarios.name: One node for a swarm of agents
scenarios.description: 20 background agent sessions with headless browsers and two concurrent builds, a model gateway and monitoring. No local model.

scenarios.name: Six businesses with their own desktops and an always-on local model
scenarios.description: Six workspaces (3 agent sessions, a headless browser and a Linux desktop container each), two Windows VMs, Langfuse on the same node, a gateway, 1M RAG chunks and a 30-35B local mixture-of-experts model.

scenarios.name: Add a business ERP and a 70B model
scenarios.description: Scenario 2 with 24 agent sessions, an Odoo instance for 15 users, 3M RAG chunks and a 70B dense local model.

scenarios.name: Add image, video and fine-tuning work on a GPU node
scenarios.description: Scenario 3 plus local image generation, 5B video generation and a 32B QLoRA fine-tune queued on a separate GPU node.
